instruction: Candid full shot of an indoor martial arts gym with gray mats. On the left, the man in the blue sleeveless shirt (R1) stands with his left leg slightly raised. On the right, the bearded man in the maroon t-shirt (R2) extends his arms to engage in a clinch. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the neutral-toned training area.
elements: R2 extends his arms to engage R1 in a clinch
R1 stands with his left leg slightly raised while R2 reaches for the clinch
R2 has the active clinch-engagement role toward R1
the setting is an indoor martial arts gym

questions.element: R1 has the raised-leg stance while R2 has the reaching clinch role
